item.title: Extract cmd-clean to lazy-loaded module
item.intent: Extract cmd_clean and _archive_done_items to .aishore/lib/cmd-clean.sh — lazy-loaded on demand, ~70 lines removed from main script, dispatch updated, bash -n passes on both files.
steps: Create .aishore/lib/cmd-clean.sh with both functions, following the same module header pattern as existing modules
Update dispatch table in main to _load_module cmd-clean before invoking cmd_clean
Run bash -n on both files to verify syntax
Run .aishore/aishore clean --dry-run to verify behavior is unchanged
acceptanceCriteria: wc -l .aishore/aishore shows at least 60 fewer lines than before this change
